svg.desc: ТПТС ([I]VL) предвыбор универсальный c текстом Dull Screen

rt:model.comment: Стандартная подмодель ПОРТАЛа для Dull Screen

rt:param.name: VL_type
rt:param.comment: Тип предвыбора (сколько из скольки). Разрешено: 1о2, 1о3, 2о3 1k2 или 1k3

rt:param.name: OneLine
rt:param.comment: Для предвыбора 1 из 2 или 1 из 3 обрезать индикатор снизу и показывать только одну строку

rt:var.name: MyStrokeWdth
rt:var.comment: Толщина рамок в зависимости от управляемости

rt:var.name: CatNr
rt:var.comment: Надо узнать, это VL (37) или IVL (30)

rt:model.rt:sub: Sub Show_Selection() If Shorter Then If (PRJSPEC.ObjectColorEx(4, Col1, 11) == Color_Sel) Then text_1.font_size = 16 * HeightRatio text_1.font_weight = "bold" text_1.text_decoration = "underline" Else text_1.font_size = 13 * HeightRatio text_1.font_weight = "normal" text_1.text_decoration = "none" End If Else If (PRJSPEC.ObjectColorEx(4, Col1, 11) == Color_Sel) Then text_1.font_size = 16 * HeightRatio text_1.font_weight = "bold" text_1.text_decoration = "underline" text_1.fill = "black" Else text_1.font_size = 13 * HeightRatio text_1.font_weight = "normal" text_1.text_decoration = "none" text_1.fill = "Col_Grey5" End If If (PRJSPEC.ObjectColorEx(4, Col2, 11) == Color_Sel) Then text_2.font_size = 16 * HeightRatio text_2.font_weight = "bold" text_2.text_decoration = "underline" text_2.fill = "black" Else text_2.font_size = 13 * HeightRatio text_2.font_weight = "normal" text_2.text_decoration = "none" text_2.fill = "Col_Grey5" End If If (PRJSPEC.ObjectColorEx(4, Col3, 11) == Color_Sel) Then text_3.font_size = 16 * HeightRatio text_3.font_weight = "bold" text_3.text_decoration = "underline" text_3.fill = "black" Else text_3.font_size = 13 * HeightRatio text_3.font_weight = "normal" text_3.text_decoration = "none" text_3.fill = "Col_Grey5" End If End If End Sub

Sub Get_Selection() If HasErr || Z0 == Nothing Then Backgr.fill = Color_ErLink Exit Sub End If
If Shorter Then Status = PRJSPEC.TPTS_VL_1(KKS, Col1, AStat) If (Status == -1)Then text_1.text = "РЕМОНТ" ElseIf ((Status & 4096) != 0) Then text_1.text = "НДСТ" ElseIf (Status <= 0) Then text_1.text = "НЕИЗВ." ElseIf ((Status & 0x3) > 0) && ((Status & 0x3C) == 0) Then text_1.text = Text1 ElseIf ((Status & 0xC) > 0) && ((Status & 0x33) == 0) Then text_1.text = Text2 ElseIf ((Status & 0x30) > 0) && ((Status & 0xF) == 0) Then text_1.text = Text3 'приоритет мигания ElseIf ((Status & 0x2A) > 0) Then If ((Status & 0x2A) == 2) Then text_1.text = "1" ElseIf ((Status & 0x2A) == 8) Then text_1.text = "2" ElseIf ((Status & 0x2A) == 32) Then text_1.text = "3" Else text_1.text = "НЕИЗВ." End If Else text_1.text = "НЕИЗВ." End If Else Status = PRJSPEC.TPTS_VL(KKS, Col1, Col2, Col3, AStat) End If If (Status == -1)Then Backgr.fill = Color_Remont ElseIf ((Status & 4096) != 0) || (Status < 0) Then Backgr.fill = Color_Inval ElseIf ((Status & 0x3F) != 0) Then Backgr.fill = "Col_BGmain" Else Backgr.fill = "Col_Grey5" End If End Sub
rt:model.rt:event:
SingleDig.visibility = "hidden" TwoDig.visibility = "hidden"
If (KKS != "NULL") Then Z0 = BIN(KKS + "_Z0") OU = BIN(KKS + "_OU") VB6 = BIN(KKS + "_VB6") Text1 = PRJSPEC.GET_KKS(KKS, 1) Text2 = PRJSPEC.GET_KKS(KKS, 2) Text3 = PRJSPEC.GET_KKS(KKS, 3) If Text1 == "Н.Д." Then Text1 = Text1 + " 1" ElseIf Len(Text1) == 0 Then Text1 = "< 1 >" End If If Text2 == "Н.Д." Then Text2 = Text2 + " 2" ElseIf Len(Text2) == 0 Then Text2 = "< 2 >" End If If Text3 == "Н.Д." Then Text3 = Text3 + " 3" ElseIf Len(Text3) == 0 Then Text3 = "< 3 >" End If Else HasErr = True End If If (Z0 != Nothing) Then CatNr = Z0.CategoryNr Else HasErr = True End If If CatNr == 37 Then //это VL HasErr = HasErr || !((VL_type == "1o2") || (VL_type == "1o3") || (VL_type == "2o3") || (VL_type == "1k2") || (VL_type == "1k3")) Else //иначе полагаем, что это IVL HasErr = HasErr || !((VL_type == "1o2") || (VL_type == "1o3") || (VL_type == "2o3") || (VL_type == "1k2") || (VL_type == "1k3") || (VL_type == "2o2") || (VL_type == "3o3")) End If If HasErr Then Backgr.fill = Color_ErLink Backgr.fill_opacity = 1 Text1 = "Ошибка" Text2 = "Ошибка" Text3 = "Ошибка" End If If Left(VL_type, 1) == "1" && OneLine Then text_2.visibility = "hidden" text_3.visibility = "hidden" Shorter = True ElseIf Right(VL_type, 1) == "2" Then text_3.visibility = "hidden" End If Dim NewHeight As Float Dim NewWidth As Float NewWidth = CInt(_This.width) If Left(VL_type, 1) == "1" && OneLine Then NewHeight = CInt(_This.height * 35.0 / 75.0) text_1.y = 22.5 * _This.height / 75.0 ElseIf Right(VL_type, 1) == "2" Then NewHeight = CInt(_This.height * 55.0 / 75.0) text_1.y = 22.5 * _This.height / 75.0 Else NewHeight = CInt(_This.height) End If
InGr.height = NewHeight body.x = 5 body.y = 5 body.width = NewWidth - 10 body.height = NewHeight - 10 Backgr.x = 5 Backgr.y = 5 Backgr.width = NewWidth - 10 Backgr.height = NewHeight - 10 SelFrame.x = 5 SelFrame.y = 5 SelFrame.width = NewWidth - 10 RB_edge.points = "5,"+CStr(NewHeight - 5)+" "+CStr(NewWidth - 5)+","+CStr(NewHeight - 5)+" "+CStr(NewWidth - 5)+",5" LU_edge.points = "5,"+CStr(NewHeight - 5)+" 5,5 "+CStr(NewWidth - 5)+",5"
